name: cv.cm
description: Free browser tools. Image, PDF, audio and AI tools process files on the user's device and never upload them.

categories.name: Share
categories.data_handling: The clipboard stores shared text and files on cv.cm for up to 24 hours or 10 views; QR and barcode run in the page.
